blurb: StageCoach Playhouse for the Arts/StageCoach Foundation, Inc. supports the Arts in our local community. In 2026, we have received numerous scholarship applications for students to attend our summer camps at low-to-no cost. Knowing that this will be the last opportunity for these camps, due to the black box theater location closing in August, we’d like to be able to cover all eligible applications received.
